title.zh: Keystone 称网站遭入侵，暴露硬件钱包买家的地址
title.en: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses

current_state.zh: Keystone 正在处置 10 月 20 日官网入侵事件：认证密钥被窃，旧密钥设备认证失效，库存 18,835 台设备将销毁，官网发货暂停至新密钥设备投产；已确认 25,964 条买家记录及 12,873 条结账记录泄露，并请求 Shopify 删除相关数据；10 月 20 日前交付设备仍视为安全，此后交付设备需额外验证。
current_state.en: Keystone is remediating the October 20 website breach: the authentication key was stolen, old-key device authentication is invalid, 18,835 inventory devices are to be destroyed, and website shipments are paused until new-key devices are produced; it confirmed 25,964 buyer records and 12,873 checkout records were leaked and has requested Shopify delete related data; devices delivered before October 20 are considered safe, while devices delivered afterward require additional verification.

updates.title_zh: Keystone 称网站遭入侵，暴露硬件钱包买家的地址
updates.title_en: Keystone says website breach exposed hardware wallet buyers’ addresses
updates.what_changed_zh: Keystone 披露了一起网站入侵事件，未经授权的第三方访问了客户收货信息，引发了对定向钓鱼和人身攻击的警告。
updates.what_changed_en: Keystone disclosed a website breach in which an unauthorized third party accessed customer shipping information, prompting warnings about targeted phishing and physical attacks.
updates.current_state_zh: Keystone 披露了一起网站入侵事件，未经授权的第三方访问了客户收货信息，引发了对定向钓鱼和人身攻击的警告。
updates.current_state_en: Keystone disclosed a website breach in which an unauthorized third party accessed customer shipping information, prompting warnings about targeted phishing and physical attacks.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Keystone disclosed a website breach in which an unauthorized third party accessed customer shipping information, prompting warnings about targeted phishing and physical attacks.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Keystone disclosed a website breach in which an unauthorized third party accessed customer shipping information, prompting warnings about targeted phishing and physical attacks.

updates.title_zh: Keystone宣布将销毁1.88万台设备，确认设备验证密钥遭泄露
updates.title_en: Keystone宣布将销毁1.88万台设备，确认设备验证密钥遭泄露
updates.what_changed_zh: Keystone 确认泄露范围包括用于验证设备真伪的认证密钥，将停用旧密钥、销毁库存中 18,835 台使用旧密钥的设备、暂停官网未发货订单配送直至新密钥设备投产，并将客户信息保留期由 180 天缩短至 90 天。
updates.what_changed_en: Keystone confirmed the leaked data included device-authentication keys, and said it will retire the old keys, destroy 18,835 inventory devices built with them, pause shipment of unfulfilled website orders until new-key devices are produced, and cut customer data retention from 180 to 90 days.
updates.current_state_zh: Keystone 正在对 10 月 20 日官网漏洞导致的数据泄露进行处置：旧设备认证密钥作废，库存 18,835 台设备销毁，官网发货暂停至新密钥设备投产，并已向 Shopify 申请删除数据（预计 11 月 3 日完成）。
updates.current_state_en: Keystone is remediating the October 20 website breach: old device-authentication keys are revoked, 18,835 inventory devices are being destroyed, website shipments are paused until new-key devices are produced, and a Shopify data-deletion request is expected to complete by November 3.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Keystone disclosed a website breach that leaked device-authentication keys and customer data, prompting it to retire the old keys, destroy 18,835 inventory devices, and pause shipments until new-key devices are produced.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Keystone disclosed a website breach that leaked device-authentication keys and customer data, prompting it to retire the old keys, destroy 18,835 inventory devices, and pause shipments until new-key devices are produced.

updates.title_zh: Keystone 漏洞事件升级：黑客窃取了用于验证钱包真伪的密钥
updates.title_en: Keystone breach deepens: Hackers stole key used to verify wallets as genuine
updates.what_changed_zh: Keystone 进一步披露：攻击者利用第三方监控工具漏洞提权，除客户信息外还窃取了设备认证密钥，可能让伪造钱包通过真伪校验；泄露的买家记录为 25,964 条，另有 12,873 条未完成结账记录被 Shopify 保留并遭窃取；10 月 20 日前已生产交付的设备仍视为安全，此后交付的设备真伪无法保证。
updates.what_changed_en: Keystone further disclosed that the attacker escalated privileges via a third-party monitoring tool vulnerability and stole a device-authentication key that could let counterfeit wallets pass authenticity checks; 25,964 buyer records were stolen, along with 12,873 incomplete checkout records retained by Shopify; devices manufactured and delivered before the October 20 incident are considered safe, while authenticity of devices delivered after that date cannot be guaranteed.
updates.current_state_zh: Keystone 正在处置 10 月 20 日官网入侵事件：认证密钥被窃，旧密钥设备认证失效，库存 18,835 台设备将销毁，官网发货暂停至新密钥设备投产；已确认 25,964 条买家记录及 12,873 条结账记录泄露，并请求 Shopify 删除相关数据；10 月 20 日前交付设备仍视为安全，此后交付设备需额外验证。
updates.current_state_en: Keystone is remediating the October 20 website breach: the authentication key was stolen, old-key device authentication is invalid, 18,835 inventory devices are to be destroyed, and website shipments are paused until new-key devices are produced; it confirmed 25,964 buyer records and 12,873 checkout records were leaked and has requested Shopify delete related data; devices delivered before October 20 are considered safe, while devices delivered afterward require additional verification.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Keystone disclosed that attackers who breached its website also stole an authentication key that could allow counterfeit hardware wallets to pass genuineness checks, widening a customer-data leak into a device-supply-chain risk.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Keystone disclosed that attackers who breached its website also stole an authentication key that could allow counterfeit hardware wallets to pass genuineness checks, widening a customer-data leak into a device-supply-chain risk.
